description: What the WebView is allowed to ask the core for. Windows owns the caption strip, so the main window needs no window-command permissions at all beyond dragging by the toolbar. Phase 7 adds the ability to open a compose window, granted narrowly: create, close, set title, and nothing else about a window. The list is deliberately granular rather than core:default - this app will hold someone's entire private correspondence, and this file is the place that stays honest about the surface the WebView can reach. The window pattern covers compose-N as well as main, because a compose window that could not close itself would be a window with no Send button that works.
